prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Try your first interaction right now to learn how your pet responds on your desktop.", "Practice Petting Pet"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop World", "Your companion is being generated and saved to your desktop account."]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready", "Click continue to review quick controls for managing your pet on desktop.", "View Pet Controls"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet's Journey", "Select a path to shape your companion's personality and daily behavior.", "Select Journey Path"]
4: ["Pick Your Companion", "Focus on each pet's unique habits before confirming your companion.", "Featured Traits"]
5: ["Secure Your Pet Account", "Sign in to backup your pet's memory, inventory, and progress across installs.", "Cloud Backup Enabled: Your pet state will be saved automatically."]
6: ["System Tray & Desktop Visibility", "Learn how to minimize your pet to the system tray whenever you need focus.", "Test Tray Minimize"]
7: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "Configuring animations, audio, and desktop movement routines...", "Loading Desktop Assets"]
8: ["Begin Your Companion Adventure", "Step 1 of 4: Story Path"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your pet certificate is officially registered. Your companion is bound to this desktop device.", "Confirm Adoption"]
